user.title: Add a ski resort
user.description: Enter your RapidAPI key and a resort name from the Ski Resort Forecast API (for example, Vail or Beaver-Creek).

data_description.resort: The resort as the forecast API spells it, e.g. Vail, Beaver-Creek, Val-dIsere.

reauth_confirm.title: Update RapidAPI key
reauth_confirm.description: The stored key stopped working for {resort}. Enter a current RapidAPI key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Ski Resort Forecast API. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The RapidAPI key was rejected. Check the key and that it is subscribed to the Ski Resort Forecast API.
error.unknown_resort: That resort name wasn't found. Check the spelling the forecast API uses (hyphens for spaces).

init.title: Ski resort options
init.description: Tune how often data is polled and enable optional lift status.

data.lifts_enabled: Enable lift status (needs the Ski Resorts and Conditions API)

data_description.elevation: Which mountain elevation the forecast summary describes: top, mid, or bot.
data_description.lift_slug: The resort slug used by the Ski Resorts and Conditions (skiapi) product, e.g. vail.
